title: 小星星
about: The French tune "Ah ! vous dirai-je, maman" (18th century), the one Mozart wrote variations on. Chinese children sing it with six lines of seven characters, one character per note. Homework from Monika, 10 Nov 2026.
lyricsHint: Paste the Chinese lyrics from the video or from Monika: 6 lines of 7 characters (42 in all). Punctuation and spaces are ignored.
